message.content: 在基督教传统里，耶稣被视为最重要、最高级别的“先知”。他不仅预言了自己的使命，还实现并完成了旧约中的所有预言，被认为是真正的弥赛亚和神之子。虽然摩西（以立法者身份）和以赛亚等旧约先知也受到极高敬仰，但耶稣在基督教信仰体系中占据核心地位，因其救赎与启示作用而被认为是最终且最具权威的先知。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "In Christianity, who is the most important prophet?" They want an answer. We can provide a short answer. According to Christian tradition, Jesus Christ is considered the greatest prophet and also the Son of God. But if they ask about prophets, maybe Moses or Isaiah? In Christianity, Jesus is considered the fulfillment of prophecy. So we should answer that Jesus Christ is considered the most important prophet, as he fulfills all prophecies and is central to Christian faith. Also mention that Moses is highly revered as the lawgiver, but Jesus is seen as the ultimate prophet.
